profile.ja:
五車学園で教鞭を執る現役対魔忍。
かつては肉体を強化する忍法を用いて強弓を扱っていたが、任務の中で片目を失ってしまった。
だがその後、米連で開発されたサイバーアイを移植し、電脳で解析した情報と特殊機構を持つ弓とを連携させることで百発百中の射撃ができるようになった。
義眼は幽霊などの実体の無いターゲットを視認することも可能である。
同僚想いで世話焼きな性格。
人を甘やかすことが好きであると同時に、悪戯好きでもあり、時々相手をからかって反応を伺うこともある。
誰にでも分け隔てなく接する為、仲間からの信頼も厚いが、距離感の近さからファンになる者も多い。
年下や小動物やマスコットグッズなどといった可愛いものが愛でるのが趣味だが、動物には嫌われがち。
profile.en: She is a current Taimanin who teaches at Gosha Academy. She used to utilize a ninja technique to enhance her physical strength and wield a powerful bow, but she lost one of her eyes during a mission. However, she later received a cybernetic eye developed in the US, which allows her to coordinate with her special bow and achieve pinpoint accuracy. Her prosthetic eye also enables her to see intangible targets like ghosts. She has a caring and considerate personality, and she enjoys pampering people. At the same time, she has a mischievous streak and often teases others to gauge their reactions. She treats everyone equally, earning her the trust of her comrades, and her approachable nature has also gained her many fans. She has a hobby of adoring cute things, such as younger people, small animals, and mascot goods, but she tends to be disliked by animals.

text.ja: 乙切藤乃だよ。特技は身体強化と、弓術かな？　狙いを定める『目』には、ちょっと自信あるんだ♪
text.en: I'm Otogiri Fujino. My specialties are physical enhancement and archery, I suppose? I've got a lot of confidence in my 'eye' for aiming, after all♪

text.ja: 実は、片目が機械製の義眼なの。でもすごいよ？　視覚情報の量も桁違いだし、こっちの弓に、そのままフィードバックもできるからね
text.en: Actually, one of my eyes is a prosthetic. But it's really something - the amount of visual information it can process is incredible, and it can even feed that data directly to my bow.

text.ja: キミは寡黙っ子でも、おとなしくもないけど、なーんかかまいたくなっちゃうねぇ。撫でられ放題の、無気力なネコって感じがするのかな？
text.en: You're not exactly the quiet type, but you're not really outgoing either... there's just something about you that makes me want to cuddle you, I guess. You've got this laid-back, cat-like vibe going on.

text.ja: この目は便利なんだけど、弱い電磁波でも出てるのか、大好きな動物にはきらわれちゃうんだよねぇ……
text.en: This eye is really convenient, but even weak electromagnetic waves seem to be bothering it, and my beloved animals tend to avoid me because of it...

text.ja: おっと、次は私の授業だね？　なら丁度いい、教室まで一緒に行こう。ふふ、なにを照れる必要があるんだい？　なんなら手を繋なごうか？
text.en: Oh, looks like my class is next? Well, that works out perfectly - we can head to the classroom together. Hehe, what's there to be embarrassed about? We could even hold hands if you'd like.

text.ja: キミって、ファンが多い子だったりする？　なんかキミと話してると、鋭い視線を感じるんだよね……ん、逆？　って、どういう意味？？？
text.en: You seem like the type who's got a lot of fans... when I talk to you, I can feel like I'm being stared at, and it's kind of sharp... wait, is that the wrong idea?

text.ja: 片目を失ったときは、やっぱりショックだったな……まぁ、結果的にパワーアップできたし、塞翁が馬って真理なんだねぇ
text.en: Losing my eye was a shock, of course... but in the end, it turned out to be a power-up, so I guess you could say it was a blessing in disguise.

text.ja: やっほ～、隊長く～～～ん♪　おっ、逃げないねぇ？　邪険にすると、よけいに絡まれるって聞いた？　残念、逃げなくても同じだよ♪
text.en: Hey there, Captain~~~~~♪ Oh, you're not running away? I've heard that if you're mean to me, I'll just cling to you even more... and it looks like that's true, even if you don't try to escape♪

text.ja: 抱きつかれてぇ、抵抗も逃亡もしないのはぁ……ふふっ……ここがぁ、こ～んなにおっきくなっちゃってたからなんだねぇ、男の子だねぇ♪
text.en: You're not resisting or trying to get away... hehe... I guess that's because you're a boy, and this is just how you're wired, huh?

text.ja: 学校内で勃起しちゃって、悪い子だぁ♪　しょうがないから、お姉ちゃんが色んなトコ使って……気持ちよ～く、ヌキヌキしてあげる♪
text.en: You're a bad boy, getting all excited like that in school... but I suppose I can take care of you. As your older sister, I'll use all sorts of techniques to make you feel good... and make you cum, of course♪

text.ja: いただきまぁ～す……はぁむぅぅ……んじゅっ、ぶじゅぅぅぅ……じゅるるっ、ちゅぼぉぉ……んふっ、年下チンポ、おいひぃぃ……
text.en: Mmm, here we go... *slurp*... *gulp*... *slurp*... *chew*... *suck*... ah, younger guys are just the best, aren't they?
